sermon.title: Becoming Disciples - October 1, 2023
sermon.series: Why Jesus Is Important to All
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: The message defines a disciple as someone disciplined who follows Jesus’ teaching and does the Father’s will. From the rich man and Lazarus it teaches that hell is real, success won’t get you to heaven, and repentance is the key; Paul’s words to Felix on righteousness, self-control and judgment are the message the world needs. It closes with Job’s steps and forgiving those who wronged us.

He cites “Revelations 20:4” for names not in the book of life (Revelation 20:15) and Matthew 12:49 for doing the Father’s will (12:50).

faqs.answer: Yes; there are handouts to follow along, thanks to Miss Woods.

faqs.question: How many times can I mess up?
faqs.answer: He says you may mess up 100 times, seven times seven, but get back to the cross.

faqs.question: How would he feel seeing an angel?
What can the spiritual body do?
faqs.answer: See, feel, taste and talk like the physical body, but it can’t die.

faqs.question: Is Rita the boss in heaven?
faqs.answer: No, he jokes; God is the boss.

faqs.question: Is being nice enough?
faqs.answer: He says he always wanted to be nice and kind to everybody, but we have to let people know.

faqs.question: What is the greatest proof?
faqs.answer: When you exercise His word and confess with your mouth, He comes and does it, even in October 2023.

faqs.question: What will you find if you look up Pauline theology?
faqs.answer: Books by people who draw all kinds of conclusions from Paul, even that Paul and not Jesus brought about Christianity; he calls that really stupid, because Paul is talking about Jesus.

faqs.question: Should we tremble at every doctrine?
faqs.answer: Not side issues we’re not sure of, but the things we are sure of.

faqs.question: Has everyone been wronged?
faqs.answer: In America, there are people who have wronged everybody; hold on to it or give it to God.
